transactionRawConfig:
# _md5hash=318bf95d8fb2bdd439cc2a723bbb62f2
# _version=31
# Dataplaneapi managed File
# changing file directly can cause a conflict if dataplaneapi is running

global
  user root
  group root
  stats socket ipv4@0.0.0.0:19999 level admin expose-fd listeners
  log stdout format raw local0
  nosplice

defaults unnamed_defaults_1
  mode http
  log global
  option httplog
  timeout connect 5s
  timeout client 30s
  timeout server 30s

userlist dataplaneapi
  user admin insecure-password edge-pilot-internal

resolvers ep_dns
  hold nx 30s
  hold obsolete 30s
  hold other 30s
  hold refused 30s
  hold timeout 30s
  hold valid 10s
  timeout resolve 1s
  timeout retry 1s
  accepted_payload_size 8192
  parse-resolv-conf
  resolve_retries 3

frontend ep_http
  mode http
  bind 0.0.0.0:80 name public
  acl febae531_b091_43a7_9fff_2c4080eade2f_host hdr(host) -i snapshot.ratgg.com
